headline: SG freebies: last week for the free Jurong Lake Gardens magnetic pin (ends Sat 14 Nov), S.U.R.E. bookmark to Sun 15 Nov + 9 more
verdict: Get to Jurong Lake Gardens by Sat 14 Nov for the free magnetic pin: everyone who finishes gets one, it needs no purchase, and the rally ends this week.

plan.do: Jurong Lake Gardens: get stamps at 3 info counters and finish the crossword for a free magnetic pin. Go early, while stocks last.
Jurong Library, Jurong East: solve the S.U.R.E. Mission 1 puzzle and take home a free limited-edition bookmark.
City Square Mall B1, Farrer Park: clear all 7 Warrior 24/7 stations for a key charm and a Beutea drink voucher. Closes 6pm.
Takashimaya B2: Nintendo Switch 2 trial plays for a free hand fan and Mario sticker sheet. Last day, single source only.
